bestBets.overview: 1000m Maiden Hcp. A dozen can run. No's 3,4,7,8,15 most likely to be up there when things 'settle'. Not a race I am at all keen to stake my 'reputation' on. Majority lightly raced, overwhelming majority unplaced leading in. OLD WERMATONG was specked at a price when resuming, juicy place odds realised for those who go each-way. NATION strips fitter for the 1st-up 5th at the Sunshine Coast. The runner-up there has since tasted defeat at bank-teller odds at Rockhampton but in fairness, the jury is yet to decide was that the fault of the horse, or the fault of the 'game plan'. JOHNNY THE FOX finished some 16 lengths from the winner on debut  but was soon 'turfed out'. Here he not only resumes but as a gelding and sports blinkers and he's won a trial leading in. Who next to consider? Those - if any - that attract market support would be my best guess.
